LEARNER WORK SAMPLE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO

A finding with a clear story

Observation
A student can read a record belonging to another test account.
Business impact
Private student information may be exposed.
Recommendation
Check record ownership on the server for every request.
Retest
Repeat the original test and verify denial across the relevant roles.

Before you begin

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Choose a course that fits your starting point and the time you can commit.

Can I join as a beginner?

Practical VAPT Foundations is intended for beginners with basic computer skills and junior IT staff. Web and API Security Testing expects familiarity with HTTP and basic VAPT. Each syllabus lists its prerequisites.

When does the first batch start?

The first VAPT batch is being planned. Dates, fees, class timings and delivery mode have not been announced. Review the syllabus now and prepare your enquiry below.

Is this official CEH training?

The current Ethical Hacking Foundations programme is independent preparation. No EC-Council training partnership is claimed. Vendor exams, eligibility, vouchers and certification are separate.

What certificate will I receive?

An academy course-completion certificate is planned for learners who meet the published assessment criteria. It does not confer CEH certification, ISO auditor accreditation or CERT-In recognition.

Is a job guaranteed?

No. Education and recruitment are separate. Any future vacancy will have its own selection process, and buying a course will not be required to apply.

What equipment do I need?

A laptop or desktop, reliable internet and the ability to run the assigned lab tools. Exact system requirements, software licences and any additional costs will be confirmed with the batch details before payment.
